add_file_descriptor_proto: add a FileDescriptorProto to the DescriptorDatabase and index its message types, enums, extensions, and services
find_file_by_name: find a FileDescriptorProto in the database by its .proto file name using FindFileByName
find_file_containing_symbol: find the FileDescriptorProto containing a fully qualified symbol like package.Message using FindFileContainingSymbol
handle_conflicting_definition_error: handle DescriptorDatabaseConflictingDefinitionError when adding a proto with the same name but different descriptor
extract_symbols_from_descriptor: use _ExtractSymbols to recursively yield fully qualified names from a descriptor proto including nested types and enums
